authorization: Root confirmed exactly one bounded repeat after first scan commands returned exit 0 but the parser reported ambiguous output lines. No further survey repeats after this batch.
reason: The first parser retained output hashes/byte counts and did not preserve raw Wi-Fi data, but three nonempty lines per band were structurally ambiguous. Counts and target matches therefore remain unknown. The revised parser records only delimiter/token counts and booleans for ambiguous lines; it never keeps their content.
execution_policy: Sequential 2.4GHz then 5GHz. Strict SSH host pin, ndmc hash check per radio, 20-second timeout, keepalives, before/after master+AP states, exact 5GHz station status before/after. Stop on nonzero, timeout, parse ambiguity does not trigger another scan, or status/management failure. No retries and no config mutation.
safety_note: Management is over Wi-Fi. 5GHz scan may briefly disturb the active WISP station and local AP. If SSH drops, save the bounded failure and do not run the next band; coordinate only one readback.
result_filter: Band, complete row count, exact White paper match count and target-only channel/quality, pre/post allowed interface statuses, timestamps, exit codes, output hashes/byte counts, structural metadata for unknown lines. No raw output, unrelated SSIDs, BSSIDs/MACs, IPs, or secrets.
freshness: No per-network timestamp is documented; record freshness as unconfirmed.
